title: ResearchOS Master System Error Ledger & Prevention Registry

history.summary: Checkmate Audit Failed: Not Found due to missing route and compile_pdf method signature mismatch
history.root_cause: latex_exporter lacked compile_pdf method and save_markdown had mismatched parameter ordering
history.resolution: Updated checkmate_audit to use compile_pdflatex and correct save_markdown argument order
history.prevention_rule: R1: All PDF compilation endpoints must invoke compile_pdflatex(tex_code, bib_code=bib_code, allow_package_fallback=True)

history.summary: Download PDF returned PDF COMPILATION ERROR due to undefined 'verifier' variable and compile_pdf call
history.root_cause: exporter.compile_pdf and verifier.audit_pdf used stale variable names
history.resolution: Replaced compile_pdf with compile_pdflatex and verifier with checkmate_verifier, streaming Response(content=pdf_bytes)
history.prevention_rule: R2: PDF export route must return binary Response with application/pdf Content-Type

history.summary: Section headings rendered as '1 1 EXECUTIVE ABSTRACT' due to LaTeX section counter appending to hardcoded markdown '1 '
history.root_cause: heading_to_section regex skipped level 1 headings (# 1 ...), retaining leading digits
history.resolution: Updated heading_to_section to strip leading numbers (re.sub(r'^(\d+[\.\s]*)+', '', title)) across all heading levels
history.prevention_rule: R3: Strip all leading numerical prefixes from markdown section titles before converting to LaTeX \section

history.summary: Page 4 rendered two separate REFERENCES headings and duplicate reference lists
history.root_cause: Markdown body ended with hardcoded ## References section alongside \bibliography{references}
history.resolution: Added regex stripping of hardcoded References sections in convert_markdown_body prior to LaTeX compilation
history.prevention_rule: R4: Automatically filter out hardcoded markdown References sections prior to appending LaTeX \bibliography

history.summary: Manuscript text spilled onto an orphan 5th page with only a few lines
history.root_cause: Uncalibrated markdown text volume caused minor overflow past the 4-page camera-ready limit
history.resolution: Tuned section text density so the document fills exactly 4 full pages with zero orphan spillover
history.prevention_rule: R5: Enforce strict 4-page layout auditing for camera-ready IEEEtran submissions

history.summary: pdflatex failed on ICML template fallback due to undefined \icmltitle macro
history.root_cause: ICML template used custom style macros that were undefined when geometry package fallback was triggered
history.resolution: Added preamble \providecommand fallback macros for \icmltitle, \icmlauthor, \icmlaffiliation, and \icmlkeywords
history.prevention_rule: R6: R6: Provide safe \providecommand fallback definitions for venue-specific custom macros in all LaTeX templates

history.summary: pdflatex failed on ACL template with '! LaTeX Error: Missing \begin{document}'
history.root_cause: ACL template placed \title, \author, and \maketitle prior to \begin{document}
history.resolution: Re-ordered ACL template to place \begin{document} before \title, \author, and \maketitle
history.prevention_rule: R7: R7: Always place \begin{document} immediately after preamble packages and before \title and \maketitle

history.summary: Abstract rendered literal ** double asterisks around keywords
history.root_cause: sanitize_latex escaped special characters but did not convert markdown bold **text** to LaTeX \textbf{text}
history.resolution: Added regex conversion re.sub(r'\*\*(.*?)\*\*', r'\\textbf{\1}', clean_abstract)
history.prevention_rule: R8: R8: Automatically convert Markdown bold (**text**) and italic (*text*) syntax into LaTeX \textbf and \textit

prevention_rules.R1: All PDF compilation endpoints must invoke compile_pdflatex(tex_code, bib_code=bib_code, allow_package_fallback=True)
prevention_rules.R2: PDF export route must return binary Response with application/pdf Content-Type
prevention_rules.R3: Strip all leading numerical prefixes from markdown section titles before converting to LaTeX \section
prevention_rules.R4: Automatically filter out hardcoded markdown References sections prior to appending LaTeX \bibliography
prevention_rules.R5: Enforce strict 4-page layout auditing for camera-ready IEEEtran submissions
prevention_rules.R6: R6: Provide safe \providecommand fallback definitions for venue-specific custom macros in all LaTeX templates
prevention_rules.R7: R7: Always place \begin{document} immediately after preamble packages and before \title and \maketitle
prevention_rules.R8: R8: Automatically convert Markdown bold (**text**) and italic (*text*) syntax into LaTeX \textbf and \textit
